extensions.status: The home page (website/index.html, website/home.css, website/home.js, and the benchmark chart drawn by bench_bars() in tools/website/build.py) is the reference implementation of this system. The other pages (download, benchmark, IDM alternative, features, help, FAQ, news, legal) render from website/styles.css, whose tokens map onto this system: the ground (--board), the tray (--paper), ink, Graphite green (--go, and --link with the same value), Geist and pill buttons. Their layouts are the older ones (sheets with bands, the IDM alternative's label), restyled. New pages and reworked sections are built from this document and home.css.

narrative.overview:
The camera never cuts. A single centred stage holds the real Grabbit window doing its work. As the visitor scrolls, the stage stays put and the copy walks through the app's four jobs beside it. The site wears the app's own palette, Graphite green (pal.py "graphite": Zinc + Emerald), at page scale: a zinc-black or near-white ground, one raised tray surface, hairlines lit along the top edge, and a single emerald that means "this is Grabbit acting". Proof comes from the app and its measured numbers. Nothing on the page is drawn to look like the app.

Density is calm and generous: a 1200px column, 160px between sections, big tight-tracked headings, muted ink for everything secondary. Colour is scarce on purpose. Emerald marks the Download action and Grabbit's own figures, and points the way (links, focus, selection) as it does in the app; the gradient lives only inside the double-chevron mark. Light and dark are equal citizens and follow the visitor's system setting by default.

IDM appears only as the benchmark's yardstick (grey bars, plain-weight figures) and as a "moving from IDM" path. It is never the frame of reference for the look.
keyCharacteristics: Zinc-black / near-white ground, one tray surface, 1px hairlines with a top light edge.
One accent, the app's emerald: filled for Download and Grabbit's own numbers, as text or a ring for links, focus and selection.
Geist in three weights, tight negative tracking, tabular figures everywhere.
Pills for controls, nested 24/16px shells for stages and cells, 8px for app windows.
Every image is the real app in its light and dark versions, framed and lifted, never mocked.
Motion plays once or runs to measured time, and every element has a finished state at rest.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: A green fill means Grabbit is acting: the Download action, or a number Grabbit measured. Never use it for decoration, a heading or IDM's bars.

rules.name: The Green Points Rule
rules.body: Green as a line or text only shows where you can go or where you are: links, focus, selection. It never fills a surface.

rules.name: The Mark Owns The Gradient Rule
rules.body: The mark's emerald gradient (Graphite green, the app's palette) appears only inside the Grabbit mark (website/assets/grabbit.svg). There is no gradient text, gradient fill or glow anywhere else.

rules.name: The Tighter As It Grows Rule
rules.body: Tracking scales with size: -0.01em at 15-18px, -0.02em at titles, -0.035 to -0.045em at headlines and display. Body copy is never tracked.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Tabular figures are set on the body, so every time, size and count lines up without extra work.

rules.name: The Only Windows Lift Rule
rules.body: Drop shadows belong to the app's windows. Panels and cells rise through a hairline and a top light edge, never through a drop shadow or a glow.

dos: Do build every page from the Ground / Tray / Ink / Mute / Hairline tokens, in both themes, defaulting to the visitor's system choice.
Do keep green fills to Download and Grabbit's own numbers, and green lines to links, focus and selection; take the values from the app's pal.py "graphite".
Do frame real app screenshots, in light and dark versions, in an 8px window with a hairline and the window lift, inside a 24/16px double bezel or a tray cell.
Do set type in Geist 400/500/600 with tracking that tightens as the size grows, and tabular figures.
Do draw every chart from its data file at build time, and show IDM in neutral ink beside Grabbit's green.
Do give every motion a finished state at rest: entrance rise once (.9s, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), bars grow once, and reduced motion or no JS shows the end state.
donts: Don't use gradient text, glows, or any gradient outside the Grabbit mark.
Don't put drop shadows on panels or cells. Only app windows lift, the nav floats, and the Download pill has its bevel.
Don't draw a mock window or retouch a screenshot. Don't use IDM artwork, and don't present Grabbit as an IDM look-alike.
Don't add a second typeface or set headings in uppercase or with wide tracking.
Don't use square corners on controls or radii outside the 4 (micro, under 20px) / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / pill set.
Don't bring back the old blue-board look (Archivo, the blue board, its bright flat green buttons, tilted labels) in any page.
